Description: Enable creators and sponsors to jointly define milestone scope, deadlines, and reserve payment in escrow before work begins.
Enable creators to submit watermark-protected draft deliverables and let sponsors review them or request revisions.
Enable sponsors to sign off on approved work, trigger secure escrow payment release, and let creators track status in real time.
As a Content Creator or Client Sponsor, I want to define a milestone with a deliverable description, due date, and payment amount, so that both parties agree on scope and cost before any work begins.
As a Client Sponsor, I want the agreed payment amount to be automatically reserved in escrow when I create a milestone, so that the creator can trust the funds are secured before starting work.
As a Content Creator, I want to upload a draft media file (image or video) against a milestone, so that the sponsor can review my work before I get paid.
As a Content Creator, I want every draft I upload to be automatically watermarked in under 5 seconds, so that my unpaid work cannot be reused or redistributed before payment.
As a Client Sponsor, I want to view the watermarked draft submitted for a milestone, so that I can judge whether it meets the agreed requirements.
As a Client Sponsor, I want to request a revision on a draft by leaving mandatory comments, so that the creator knows exactly what to fix before I approve the milestone.
As a Client Sponsor, I want to formally sign off on an approved draft deliverable, so that the creator is paid promptly and the transaction is non-repudiable.
As a Content Creator, I want the escrowed funds to be released automatically the moment the sponsor signs off, so that I receive payment without having to chase it manually.
As a Content Creator, I want a live dashboard showing the status and escrowed amount of every milestone across my contracts, so that I always know where each payment stands.
